settings.landscapeDescription: Allow the interface to rotate when the device is turned.
settings.awakeDescription: Prevent the screen from dimming or sleeping while MirrorVue is in the foreground.

gestures.doubleTap: Double-tap the mirror to show or hide the controls.
gestures.zoom: Spread two fingers apart on the live mirror to zoom in. Pinch them together to zoom out.
gestures.brightness: Slide two fingers up together on the live mirror to brighten the screen, or down to dim it.

about.description: MirrorVue turns your Android device into a fullscreen digital mirror using the front-facing camera.
about.privacy: Privacy: the camera preview is displayed locally. MirrorVue does not upload or transmit your image or video.

camera.permissionMessage: MirrorVue needs camera access to show your mirror. Allow access to continue.
camera.inUseMessage: Another app is using the camera. Close that app, then try again.
camera.startFailed: The camera could not start. Try again in a moment.
camera.waiting: The front camera is not available yet. Please wait a moment.

donation.intro: MirrorVue is free, with no ads, and fully functional for everyone!
donation.support: If you find the app useful, you can support the development through a voluntary donation.
donation.unavailable: Donations are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
donation.pending: Your donation is still being processed by Google Play.
donation.unconfirmed: The donation could not be confirmed.
donation.unfinished: The purchase was completed, but it could not be finalized yet.
donation.failed: The donation could not be completed.
donation.networkError: Check your internet connection and try again.
